departments.name: Department name
departments.managerHint: Only active users holding the manager role are listed.
departments.servicesHint: After creation, change responsible services on the routing matrix.
departments.deactivateHint: The department stops receiving new orders. Existing order history is preserved.
departments.activateHint: The department receives orders again according to the routing matrix.

users.description: Internal accounts, roles and report access.
users.rolesHint: A person may hold several roles; permissions are the union of them.
users.rolesLimitedHint: A department manager can only grant the Staff and Sale roles.
users.departmentLocked: New accounts always belong to your department.
users.managerDescription: Staff of {{department}}. You can create Staff and Sale accounts for your department; editing, locking or resetting a password needs an administrator.
users.emailLocked: The email is the login name and cannot be changed after creation.
users.allOrders: View all orders (read-only) — for pricing staff
users.tempPasswordHint: Leave empty and the system generates one, shown once.
users.tempPasswordWarning: Shown once only. Send it to the user before closing this dialog.
users.resetPasswordHint: The old password stops working and the user must change it at the next sign-in.
users.lockHint: A locked account cannot sign in. Order history is preserved.
users.unlockHint: The account can sign in again immediately.

orders.asSale: As the person who created the orders
orders.asPricing: As the person who priced them
orders.listTitle: {{count}} most recent orders created by this person
orders.empty: This person has not created any orders

services.description: The ten company services: response deadline and milestone template.
services.name: Service
services.milestonesNotice: Changes apply only to orders closed after saving. Already closed orders keep their own snapshot.
services.unroutedWarning: No department is responsible for: {{services}}. Orders for these services land in the unrouted queue.
services.codeHint: Three capital letters, used as the order code prefix (DOM, CBT…). Cannot be changed later.
services.milestonesHint: One milestone per line, in order. The last one is usually acceptance.
services.childrenNotice: Each sub-service carries one OF1-TMS transport mode. Only orders with a mode can be pushed to TMS.
services.cannotDelete: Orders already use this sub-service, so it cannot be deleted. Turn it off instead.
services.noChildren: This service has no sub-services yet.
services.childRequired: This service needs a sub-service as well

routing.description: Tick the services each department is responsible for, then save the row. This is the routing table for automatic distribution. On save, a newly entitled department also picks up existing orders whose price is not settled yet; orders already closed, cancelled or with a winning department stay put. Tick “Sales dept” for the sales department: it never takes part in quoting.
routing.isSalesHint: Ticked = sales department: its sales reps can create orders for every service, but the department never quotes (no distribution, no transfers in).
routing.isQuotingHint: Ticked = QUOTING department: the only department that receives and quotes orders. Sales can only close a price sent by it. OTHER departments ticking a service = their dispatchers and manager can view CLOSED orders of that service (read-only).

serviceFields.title: Create-order input boxes — {{service}}
serviceFields.cargoHint: Unticking one removes it from this service’s form. These remain the only data used to match reference prices, so only drop the ones the service genuinely never uses.
serviceFields.empty: This service has no boxes of its own yet.
serviceFields.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores. Fixed once created, because existing orders store their values under it.
serviceFields.label: Label

customers.description: Customer directory, built up from orders over time.
customers.detailDescription: Customer profile and figures within your permission scope.
customers.oneNameRequired: May be left empty when a contact name is given.
customers.revenueScopeHint: Counts only orders whose value you may see.
customers.deleteConfirm: Delete customer "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
customers.beeLogsHint: A Bee Logistics customer — recognised by the @beelogistics.com email domain.

awaitingInfo.hint: This order came from the customer quote form and is still missing: {{fields}}. Fill them in and save — it moves on to the departments automatically.

create.description: The order code is generated automatically and the order is distributed at once to every department responsible for the service.
create.newCustomerHint: This customer is not in the directory yet. The profile is created together with the order, or reused when the name already exists.
create.cargoHint: Optional, but the more you fill in, the better the reference price the quoting department sees. These are the only fields used for matching.
create.noteHint: Free text. It is not used to match reference prices.
create.codePrefixHint: The order code will start with {{prefix}} and is generated by the system.
create.uploadFailed: The order was created but file {{name}} failed to upload: {{message}}
create.distributedHint: The order was distributed automatically to every department responsible for this service. They will pick it up and quote.
create.unroutedHint: No department is responsible for this service yet, so the order waits in the unrouted queue for an administrator.
create.serviceFieldsHint: These boxes are configured by an administrator for this service. The more you fill in, the less the quoting departments have to ask.
create.customerMore: Showing part of the list — {{count}} more. Type a name, CL code or tax code to search.

list.description: Quotes within your permission scope. Filters live in the URL so the view can be shared.
list.search: Search by order code or customer

kanban.description: Grouped by status. Each column shows at most {{limit}} orders.
kanban.dragHint: Drag a card onto Closed, Rejected or Cancelled to run that action. The other statuses move on their own as the order is worked.
kanban.dragNoAction: This status moves on its own as the order is worked; it cannot be set by a drag.

detail.amountHidden: This order is closed but you may not see its value.
detail.noDepartmentsHint: The order sits in the unrouted queue.
detail.awaitingInfoNoDepartments: Not distributed yet — information is missing
detail.awaitingInfoNoDepartmentsHint: Fill in the origin, the destination and the service's required fields, then save. The order moves on to the departments by itself.
detail.sealedOtherDepartmentsHint: Each department's quote is visible only to that department and the order's sales owner.
detail.noMilestonesHint: Milestones are generated the moment the order is closed.
detail.milestonesReadOnly: Only the responsible department can update progress.
detail.completedAt: Accepted and completed at {{at}}. The order status stays "Closed" — revenue was locked at closing.
detail.acceptanceHint: Record the acceptance result: who received it, the condition of the goods, any issue.
detail.acceptanceNeedsFile: Acceptance needs at least one delivery photo or signed acceptance record before it can be completed.
detail.skipNeedsNote: Skipping a milestone requires a note.
detail.noCommentsHint: Discussion on the order replaces email threads.
detail.mentionHint: Type @ to mention someone already in the thread.
detail.noFilesHint: Attached paperwork, photos and reports appear here.
detail.notClosedYet: Not closed — the value is set when the order closes

tms.unknown: Not sure whether order {{code}} reached OF1 — the connection dropped. Resending is safe: OF1 keys on the order code, so the same code updates rather than creating a second order.
tms.warningsHint: The order reached OF1. OF1 could not handle the points below — fix them and send again (same order code updates, never duplicates).
tms.failedMessage: OF1 did not accept this order
tms.missingTitle: This order is missing information required by TMS
tms.missingBody: Fill in the fields below, then send again:
tms.customerFix: The customer code lives on the customer record, not on the order. Open Customers → find this order’s customer → Edit → fill in the code.
tms.nowComplete: The order is complete — press "Send quote to TMS" to send it
tms.missingLocationHint: A location's OF1 id lives under Pricing → Locations, not on the order. On the order you only pick the right location from the catalogue.

close.title: Close the order
close.lockHint: Closing records this number as the order's revenue. Later edits to the winning quote will not move it. The milestone set for the service is generated at the same time.

reject.title: Customer rejected the order
reject.description: Record that the customer did not take the offer. The reason feeds win-rate analysis, so it comes from a fixed list.

cancel.title: Cancel the order
cancel.description: Cancel for an internal reason. A cancelled order cannot move on.
cancel.differsFromReject: Cancelling is not a rejection: it is an internal decision and stays out of the win-rate denominator. If the customer said no, use "Customer rejected".

edit.title: Edit {{code}}
edit.closedHint: This order is closed. Every change needs a documented reason and appears on the timeline.
edit.serviceChildHint: The sub-service carries the TMS mode. Without it the order cannot be sent to OF1-TMS.
edit.tmsMissingHint: The fields outlined in red are what OF1-TMS still needs.
edit.tmsCustomerHint: The customer is edited on the customer record, not on the order: the customer code belongs to the profile and every order shares it.
edit.locationHint: Pick a location from the catalogue. OF1 needs the location's id, not a typed address.
edit.changeNoteHint: Mandatory for a closed order — the backend rejects a change without it.

signature.title: Customer signature
signature.waiting: Waiting for the customer. Link expires {{han}}.
signature.expired: The link has expired. Send again if still needed.
signature.blockedClosed: The order has ended; it can no longer be sent for signing.
signature.blockedNoQuote: Pick the winning quote first — the sheet needs an amount before there is anything to sign.

nhan.done: You are now the sale for this order

reference.title: Reference prices from won orders
reference.criteria: Matching criteria: same service, closest route, comparable size (weight, volume, package count, container type). Historical support only, never a suggested price.
reference.emptyHint: No closed order was close enough to serve as a reference. Quote from the department's own experience.

form.title: Quote from {{department}}
form.firstHint: Send a single number: the order value your department commits to.
form.updateHint: Your department is on version v{{current}}. Submitting again creates version v{{next}} and replaces the current number.
form.amountHint: Whole dong, minimum 1. Thousands are grouped as you type.
form.amountRequired: Enter the order value before submitting the quote.
form.scopeNoteHint: State what is included and excluded — the sale reads this when comparing.
form.blockedByPass: Your department passed on this order, so it can no longer quote. Talk to the owning sale to take it back.
form.claimFirst: Nobody has claimed this order yet. Open the department queue and press "Claim" — whoever claims it enters the quote.
form.ownedBy: {{name}} is responsible for quoting this order.
form.blockedByLoss: Another department won this order. Your quote is kept as history.
form.blockedByRound: Quoting is closed: the order has passed the selection round. The owning sale can reopen it with a revision request.
form.listedNeedsAddress: No specific pickup/delivery address yet — choose one under "Edit order" and this route’s listed price will appear here.

compare.title: Quote comparison
compare.subtitle: Each responsible department sends one number. The owning sale decides after talking to the customer.
compare.decideHint: The lowest amount is highlighted only; nothing is selected automatically. The decision belongs to the sale.

revision.title: Request a quote revision
revision.description: Pick the departments that should quote again and state why. The reason reaches them as a comment on the order.
revision.warning: This reopens quoting for every department selected, and undoes the winner selection if one was made.

select.title: Select the winning quote
select.description: Select {{department}} at {{amount}}. That department becomes responsible for the order.
select.notClosingHint: Selecting a quote does not record revenue. The order moves to awaiting customer; revenue is locked only when the order is closed.

history.title: Superseded versions
history.empty: No version has been superseded yet.

salePrice.title: Price agreed with customer
salePrice.label: Price agreed with customer
salePrice.tooLow: Cannot be lower than the department price. Ask the department to re-quote instead.
salePrice.done: Agreed price saved and sent to the customer
salePrice.empty: Sale has not entered the agreed price yet
salePrice.hint: Website order: the customer only receives a quote once Sale enters the agreed price. Contract and revenue use this price.
salePrice.hintOther: Optional. Left empty, the contract and revenue use the department price; once entered, they use the agreed price.
salePrice.dungGiaPhongBan: Not entered — using the department price {{amount}}

dashboard.description: Figures follow your permission scope. Revenue is measured by the closing date, never the creation date.

tiles.noComparison: No data for the previous period

revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.subtitle: Click a column to see the orders behind the number.
revenue.pageDescription: Revenue over time and by dimension. Every figure is measured by the closing date.
revenue.emptyHint: Revenue is recorded only when an order is closed.

funnel.title: Order funnel
funnel.subtitle: How many orders sit at each status. Click a bar to list them.

winRate.title: Win rate
winRate.subtitle: The denominator is decided orders: closed or customer-rejected. Internal cancellations are excluded.
winRate.emptyHint: The win rate appears once an order is closed or rejected.
winRate.noReasons: No order was rejected in this range.

breakdown.title: Revenue breakdown
breakdown.subtitle: Click a row to see the orders that make up the number.

drill.title: Orders behind the number
drill.byPeriod: Orders closed in the selected period
drill.capped: Showing the first {{count}} orders. Open the order list for the rest.

responseTime.title: Response time
responseTime.subtitle: Average time from distribution to the claim and to the first quote.

competition.title: Quote competition
competition.subtitle: How many orders each department joined and how many it won. Click a row to list them.
competition.avgDepartmentsHint: Average number of departments competing on an order

operations.description: Funnel, response times, quote competition and workload.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: In-app notification is the primary channel. Email is only a nudge.
notifications.emptyHint: Notifications appear when an order arrives, a quote is submitted or a milestone moves.

myTasks.description: What is waiting for you, the longest-waiting item first.
myTasks.emptyHint: Every order in your part of the flow has been dealt with.

profile.description: Your account details and e-mail preferences.
profile.changePasswordHint: Enter your current password, then set a new one (at least 8 characters).
profile.passwordSameAsCurrent: The new password must differ from the current one.
profile.emailPreferencesHint: Switching a type off stops its e-mail. Remember to save.
profile.inAppAlwaysOn: In-app notifications cannot be switched off — they are the primary channel. These switches only affect e-mail.

queue.description: Orders distributed to {{department}}. The screen refreshes itself every minute.
queue.noDepartment: Your account belongs to no department, so there is no queue.
queue.emptyDescription: No order has been distributed to your department.

pass.title: Pass order {{code}}
pass.description: The sale will see that your department opted out, together with this reason.

assignDialog.title: Assign order {{code}}
assignDialog.description: Pick a member of your department to handle this order. They are notified.
assignDialog.noMembers: Your department has no active members yet.

queue.transferHint: Your department stops working on this order. The receiving department is queued and notified.
queue.transferNoTarget: No department is available to receive this order
queue.truncated: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} orders. The queue is longer than one page — older orders are not on this screen.

unrouted.description: Orders whose service has no responsible department yet, waiting for an administrator.
unrouted.warning: {{count}} order(s) are unrouted. Add a responsible department on the routing matrix, or attach one directly per order.
unrouted.assignDescription: A department attached outside the matrix is recorded as an exception.
unrouted.emptyDescription: Every service with orders has a responsible department.

form.title: Title
form.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens. e.g. shipping-tips
form.excerptHint: Shown on the landing list (up to 500 characters)
form.bodyHint: Rich text; upload images from the toolbar.
form.bodyPlaceholder: Write the article — use the toolbar for images, headings, lists…

confirmDelete.title: Delete article
confirmDelete.body: Permanently delete "{{title}}"? This cannot be undone.

logos.title: Partner logos
logos.added: Logo added — the home page updates in a moment
logos.name: Logo name
logos.show: Hidden — switch on to show on the home page
logos.hide: Shown — switch off to hide from the home page
logos.deleteBody: The "{{name}}" logo will be removed from the home page. To hide it for now, use the switch instead.
logos.hint: Drag the ⋮⋮ handle (or use the arrows) to reorder — the top of the list is the start of the row. New logos go to the end of the row. Use a transparent background and light lettering — the row sits on a dark ground. The "34+ / 17+" figures count the logos currently shown.

addService.title: Add a new service
addService.name: Service name
addService.slugViHint: The part after /dich-vu/ — lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.
addService.slugEnHint: The part after /services/ on the English site.
addService.slugShape: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only
addService.slugTaken: Another page already uses this URL
addService.beeopsNote: The service also joins the BeeOps catalogue, so clients can pick it on the quote form. Milestones and the owning department are set on the Services screen.
addService.optionalNote: Fields left empty keep their starter text — you can edit them any time.
addService.failed: Could not add the service; try again
addService.contentFailed: The service was created but its content could not be saved. Open the service page in the list on the left and fill it in again.
addService.added: Service added. Your content is saved — open it below to keep editing.
addService.previewTitle: This is how the page will look
addService.previewHint: A scaled-down sketch that follows every word you type on the right.

group.basicHint: The name shows in the menu and on the home cards; the URL is the page address.
group.head: Page head
group.headHint: A one-line summary for the home card, and the page's opening paragraph.
group.problemsHint: Three things that typically go wrong without this service.
group.approachHint: Three steps, in the order the work actually runs.
group.scopeHint: Four bullet points: what this service covers.
group.faqHint: The two questions clients ask most.
group.seoHint: Text shown on Google and when the link is shared; not on the page itself.
group.photoHint: Shown on the home card and in this page's "Problems clients face" block.

field.metaTitleHint: About 60 characters. Leave empty to use the service name.
field.metaDescriptionHint: About 150 characters, written around the words clients search for.

preview.introPlaceholder: The page's opening paragraph appears here.
preview.metaPlaceholder: The description under the title on Google.

addService.photoDefault: None chosen — the shared service photo is used
addService.photoWrongType: Only JPG, PNG, WEBP or GIF images are accepted
addService.photoTooBig: The photo is over {{mb}}MB, pick a smaller one
addService.photoFailed: Could not upload the photo; try again

cms.imagesShared: Images are shared by both languages: replacing one here changes the Vietnamese and English pages alike.
cms.usingDefaultImage: Using the default image from the source code
cms.seoPreviewNote: This is how the page looks on Google. None of this text appears anywhere on the page, so edit it in the fields under each result.
cms.sharePreviewNote: This is the image shown when the link is pasted into Facebook or Zalo. The server draws it, so it only changes AFTER SAVING. Facebook and Zalo also cache the old image for a while on links already shared.
cms.confirmSaveTitle: Save and publish to the live site?
cms.confirmSaveBody: Saving puts the content on the landing site straight away, with no approval step. If it is wrong, edit again or press Restore to go back to the original.
cms.socialHint: Flip the switch to hide a channel without losing its address. Clearing the address drops the channel entirely. Type the full https:// prefix.
cms.searchPlaceholder: Search by text on the page…

pricing.sessionActivateBody: The session in effect moves to archived. The new prices apply immediately for everyone.
pricing.sessionDeleteAsk: Delete “{{name}}”? Only a draft can be deleted.
pricing.sessionEmpty: No price sessions yet. Create one to start entering prices.
pricing.priceEmpty: This session has no price rows yet.
pricing.sameEndpoints: From and To must be different
pricing.importNeedSession: Pick or create a price session first — a price list always belongs to a session.
pricing.importMerged: {{count}} duplicate rows in the file; the last one won.
pricing.importRunningHint: A large file may take a few seconds. Do not close the page.
pricing.importHint: Starting from nothing? Use "Download template" — it has the right columns and a Catalogue sheet to copy names from. Already have prices? Export, edit in Excel, import back.
pricing.locationOf1IdHint: Location id in the OF1-TMS master data, issued by Bee Logistics. Several locations may share one id. Leave it blank and orders still go to TMS using the text address.
pricing.locationSearchHint: Search by name, province, region, address or OF1 code
pricing.locationEmpty: No locations yet. Add a warehouse, yard or port to build routes.
pricing.locationOffHint: Disable rather than delete: the location is already in an archived session, and deleting it would leave that session missing one end of a route.
pricing.importActiveTitle: Import into the price list in use?
pricing.importActiveBody: "{{name}}" is the list customers are quoted from. Importing changes prices immediately: rows with the same route and service are overwritten, new rows are added.
pricing.noSessionYet: No price session yet. A price table always belongs to a session — create the first one under "Price sessions", then you can import a file.
pricing.viewHint: The list prices currently in force. Use Export to take a copy with you.

region.hint: Routes grouped by region. Each route has a pickup point, a delivery point and its own price per service.
region.routesHint: Pickup → delivery, with a price per service.
region.routeEmpty: This region has no routes yet.
region.deleteRouteAsk: Delete route {{route}} and all its service prices?
region.duplicateService: This sub-service is already on the route
region.noServiceChild: No active sub-services — add them under Admin › Services.
region.priceRowHint: One row per vehicle load. At least one of the two prices is required.
region.locationsHint: Each location belongs to one region. The pickup location’s region decides which region a route sits in.
region.locationRegionHint: Leave empty when adding = inherit from another location in the same province.
region.routeRegionFrom: This route sits in {{region}} — from its pickup location.
region.routeRegionMissing: The pickup location has no region, so this route belongs to none. Assign one on the Locations tab.
region.deleteRegionBlocked: Region {{name}} still has {{count}} locations. Move them to another region on the Locations tab first.
region.duplicateUnit: This unit is already on the service
region.roundTripKmHint: For the whole route, not per vehicle type.
region.excelHint: Template → fill → import, or export → edit → import. Same file structure.
region.sessionViewHint: View only. Adding routes, editing prices and Excel import live on the Regions & routes tab.
region.noSessionYet: No price session yet. Import a price table on the Regions & routes tab and the first session is created for you.
region.archivedReadOnly: This session is archived — view only. Pick another session or create a new one to edit prices.
region.roundTripRule: Round trip = one way + 50%, filled in automatically — overwrite it if a route has its own deal.
region.excelOneWayNote: Prices in the file go to the one-way field; round trip is one way + 50%.
region.duplicateKind: A route has at most one FCL block and one LCL block
region.managerHint: The manager in charge. Only they can see this region’s prices — admins and directors still see everything.
region.activeNoImport: This session is active, so Excel import is disabled. To import a new price list: open "Manage price sessions", create a new session (optionally copied from this one), import into it, then publish.

scorecard.title: Staff scorecard
scorecard.noRateHint: No order has reached a decision yet — different from 0%.
scorecard.hint: The conversion rate counts orders that have REACHED A DECISION, not all orders: counting live orders in the denominator drags the rate down at exactly the speed someone takes on new work.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: Set who can open and act on each business screen, by role within the company.

levelHint.none: Screen is hidden from the menu

permissions.lockedHint: An administrator never loses access to this screen — otherwise one wrong click locks the whole company out of the only screen that can grant access back.
permissions.search: Search by screen or group name
permissions.noMatchHint: Try another name or a group name, such as "Reports".

partnerSignup.title: Bee Logistics partner
partnerSignup.subtitle: Open an account to follow your company's orders.
partnerSignup.emailHint: Only @beelogistics.com addresses can open this account.
partnerSignup.codeSent: A 6-digit code went to {{email}}. It lasts 5 minutes.
partnerSignup.done: Account created for {{email}}. You can sign in now.
partnerSignup.partnerLink: A Bee Logistics partner? Open an account

terms.description: Write the shipping terms customers sign. Active clauses are joined into one document when a request is sent.
terms.fieldBodyHint: No need to type "1." — numbering follows the position in the list.
terms.deleteConfirm: Delete "{{name}}"? Past signatures keep their own full text and are unaffected.
terms.noneActive: No clause is active — sending for signature will fail. Add at least one.

settings.title: System settings
settings.description: Parameters you can change without a redeploy.
